notes:
v2.0.0 — cross-platform release

- Windows + Linux native builds are here. A new PySide6 GUI ships in the same release alongside the macOS DMG; both apps share the same core image pipeline so output is identical.
- macOS DMG now bundles the default background-removal model (isnet-general-use, ~170 MB). First-run BG removal works instantly — no 170 MB download to wait for. The other three rembg models still download on demand into ~/.u2net the way they always have.
- Internal refactor: pure logic split out into core.py so both the AppKit and Qt apps reuse the exact same palettes, prompt templates, and conversion functions.
- All three platforms (macOS / Windows / Linux) ship together from a single GitHub Actions workflow on every tag push.
